title: Understanding One-Hot Encoding
text: One-hot encoding is a process of converting categorical data variables so they can be provided to machine learning algorithms to improve predictions. Each category is transformed into a binary vector.

title: Alphabetical Order of Colors
text: The colors in the list are blue, green, pink, purple, and red. Arrange them alphabetically to determine the order of columns in the design matrix.

title: Structure of the Design Matrix
text: Each color will have its own column in the design matrix. For each data point, the column corresponding to the color will have a $$1$$, and all other columns will have 0s.

title: Calculate the Number of Zeros
text: Given that there are $$5$$ colors and $$5$$ data points, calculate the total number of entries in the design matrix. Then, determine how many of these entries are zeros.
